style.es: Write neutral, idiomatic Spanish using the informal tú form. Keep UI copy concise and natural rather than literal.
style.pt-BR: Write natural Brazilian Portuguese using você. Keep UI copy concise and idiomatic rather than literal.
style.fr: Write natural French using vous. Keep UI copy concise and avoid literal calques.
style.de: Write natural German using Sie. Keep UI copy concise; prefer common shorter terms over long compounds.
style.it: Write natural Italian using tu. Keep UI copy concise and idiomatic rather than literal.
style.zh: Write natural Simplified Chinese (简体中文). Use 你 (informal), not 您. Keep UI copy concise and use standard software terminology. Translate every string fully; do not copy English source text except listed product and platform names.
style.vi: Write natural Vietnamese using bạn. Keep UI copy concise and idiomatic rather than literal. Translate every string fully; do not copy English source text except listed product and platform names.
